name: AstroFabric API
description: Deploy autonomous AI agents to discover, verify, enrich and stream high-fidelity company, person and market intelligence into your existing systems. Authenticate every call with an API key: `Authorization: Bearer ek_live_...`. Webhook deliveries are HMAC-signed and retried with backoff (at-least-once). Renamed tools, agents and scopes keep working under their old names; retired names answer 410 and are listed under `x-deprecations`.
